column11: Why do they say you carry a knife?;Who are you, really?;Why do you call me Little Ember?;What are you doing out here so late?;Can we keep each other's secrets?

column9: Turn the talk toward the blade Sahra has heard you carry, so that she asks about it or names the rumor.
The night is almost over. Offer Sahra the truce now: each of you keeps the other's secret.
